kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin shows what the company earns after direct costs.
kpis.description: Insurance activities have high gross margins because direct costs are primarily claims-related.
kpis.signal: Very high margin typical of an insurance company.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving through better overhead management.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development spending in revenue.
kpis.description: Zurich is increasing R&D spending via Zurich Global Ventures and partnerships with startups.

kpis.name: Investments (semi: fabs)
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Investments support the development of digital solutions for customers.
kpis.signal: Capex oriented toward digitalization and digital platforms.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Zurich is optimizing headcount while developing its technology operations.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction despite digital growth.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 30.0 CHF last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 5.082 Bn CHF last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 74.8% last year.

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of digital projects including artificial intelligence tools.
kpis.description: Through partnerships with riskine and other startups, Zurich is integrating AI into one third of its new digital projects.
kpis.signal: Growing AI adoption in insurance solutions.

ai_positioning.summary: Zurich is adopting artificial intelligence primarily through partnerships with startups and internal initiatives via Zurich Global Ventures. AI is used for risk analysis, product personalization, and improving customer experience.
evidence: Partnership with riskine for personal risk analysis via AI
AI feature integration in 30% of new digital deals
Zurich Innovation Championship targets AI solutions for insurance
